name: bam-asr-benchmark
description:
Bambara ASR Benchmark
	

The first standardized evaluation set for Automatic Speech Recognition in Bambara (Bamanankan). One hour of studio-quality constitutional text, transcribed and validated by linguists from Mali's Direction Nationale de l'Éducation Non Formelle et des Langues Nationales (DNENF-LN).
This benchmark accompanies the paper "Where Are We at with Automatic Speech Recognition for the Bambara Language?" and the public leaderboard at MALIBA-AI/bambara-asr-leaderboard.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/sudoping01/bam-asr-benchmark.
reputation: The first standardized ASR evaluation set for Bambara (Bamanankan); accompanies a paper and a public MALIBA-AI leaderboard and is recognized within the low-resource ASR research community.
